title: The HALO Engine: $\mathcal{O}(1)$-Step Compilation and Localized String Rupture for Lattice Gauge Theories on Quantum Hardware
summary: Simulating real-time dynamics in lattice gauge theories (LGTs) is severely constrained by the circuit depth overhead of standard fermion-to-qubit mappings, which scale linearly or quadratically with system size. To overcome this depth-scaling bottleneck, we introduce the Hardware-Aware Lattice Optimization (HALO) compiler, an architecture executing global time-evolution in an immutable $\mathcal{O}(1)$ circuit depth per Trotter step.
